The test image shows a mango leaf with scattered dark black spots/patches distributed across the green leaf surface. The spots appear as irregular dark blotches, not a powdery coating. This could be Anthracnose or Sooty Mould.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The Sooty Mould reference image is a near-perfect visual match to the test image: same irregular dark black/dark green blotches scattered across the green leaf surface, same distribution pattern, same texture. The spots are not discrete necrotic lesions (Anthracnose) nor a white powdery coating (Powdery_Mildew) nor tip dieback (Die_Back).
